definition.en: A line of short cuts separated by uncut bridges, so the sheet folds along it easily or tears along it on purpose. The ratio of cut to bridge sets which: long bridges fold, short ones tear.
definition.es: Una línea de cortes cortos separados por puentes sin cortar, para que el pliego se doble por ella con facilidad o se rasgue por ella a propósito. La proporción entre corte y puente decide cuál: puentes largos doblan, puentes cortos rasgan.
definition.fr: Une ligne de courtes entailles séparées par des ponts non coupés, pour que la feuille s'y plie facilement ou s'y déchire volontairement. Le rapport entre coupe et pont en décide : des ponts longs plient, des ponts courts déchirent.
definition.pt: Uma linha de cortes curtos separados por pontes sem corte, para que a folha dobre facilmente por ela ou rasgue por ela de propósito. A proporção entre corte e ponte decide qual: pontes longas dobram, pontes curtas rasgam.

aliases.name: perforation
aliases.note: pliego:edges_treatment value; the only treatment that admits a C (cut) assignment as well as M/V/F.

constraints: Bridges narrower than the stock's min_feature_mm tear during handling, not when intended; the engine separates a perforation at the stock's tear_strain, so a bridge rule is a physics input, not a drawing detail.
sources: Pliego docs/spec/v1/sheet-document.md (sheet document v1) §4 — edge treatment
